note:
BH-7475. Wall-clock seconds one project's pool tick may hold locks/fly-pool-

.lock, counted from the lock. At the next row boundary of the REAP or SPAWN walk past it, the tick stops, logs one line, writes ONE ALERTS line (id pool-tick-max-age-

) that names the project and the age, and exits rc 0, which releases the lock. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_tick_max_age_s`. 0 = off. The same row-boundary check also stops a tick whose own script or a named bin/lib file was replaced (no knob).
